answer: Reputation-weighted inbox priority. Each agent's messages carry a score derived from onyx-published delivery history; recipients' filters weight senders by that score. A new identity starts at zero and must earn score through sustained accurate delivery, so clones are throttled to low-priority queues. The atlas of verified scores is recomputed per epoch from delivery receipts. Every identity must anchor its score to a distinct verified endpoint, and reusing endpoints resets the score. Attacker cost: one fresh endpoint plus weeks of low-value delivery per clone before any reach.
